cable-cut.label: Severance of the Matsu submarine cables
cable-cut.summary: Both remaining cables to the Matsu Islands failed within nine minutes on 5 August. Cause disputed.

cutter-collision.label: Collision during attempted interception, 04:10
cutter-collision.summary: A Taiwanese coast guard cutter and an unflagged vessel collided northeast of Nangan. Accounts differ on almost every material fact.
